listing.name: Warhammer 40000: Banished Imperium
listing.summary: After spending a century in isolation due to a terrible warp storm, Tesalia, sector capital, finds itself free in a strange corner of the galaxy; full of non-imperial human civilizations ripe for conquest, strange technologies, and no knowledge of the God Emperor.

description:
[0.98a] BANISHED IMPERIUM 1.1.1

After spending a century in isolation due to a terrible warp storm, Tesalia, sector capital, finds itself free in a strange corner of the galaxy; full of non-imperial human civilizations ripe for conquest, strange technologies, and no knowledge of the God Emperor. The Imperial Navy sallies forth to rectify this situation.

This mod adds the Imperium of Man from Warhammer 40.000 as a fully functional NPC faction with its own system, 12 new spaceships and 9 new weapons.

DOWNLOAD

SHIPS

Spoiler

WEAPONS

Spoiler

SCREENSHOTS

Spoiler

COMPATIBILITY

I will be honest, i havent really checked if this is compatible with giant mods like say, Nexerelin. I have 0 clue if it will work with that, and its not something i plan to look into any time soon. But it should be fine with other faction mods (like Orky Sector).

NOTES

Future plans and hopes for this mod include: new ships, a station, new subfactions with a few unique ships and gear (mechanicus, space marines), and hopefully missions and colony threats (these are more unlikely due to my near zero knowledge of coding). When, i have no clue.

Some of the art in this mod is a placeholder taken from GW material, notably the portraits and some planetary art. I would like to also make my own art for these elements, but its not something i have practice in, so when is also unkown.

The mod should hopefully be balanced, as many stats are based on vanilla stuff. I have been able to beat most vanilla enemies with fleets using mostly the contents of this mod, without making late game enemies trivial. I greatly appreciate any feedback on mod balance, art, suggestions, etc.

Many, many thanks to the great folk of the Unofficial Starsector Discord modding channels, without whose help this mod would not have been possible.

GW please dont nuke me from orbit its just some silly pixel art
